purpose: Separate TCP's query-conditional value from a target-only global action under the same registered target roles and Recall@10=.95 event.
selection: TARGET_GLOBAL chooses the lowest global action whose one-sided CP UCB on the 500 selection queries is <=.05; TCP_REGISTERED reuses the registered target shift without refitting.
certification: Candidate and endpoint each use the disjoint 500-query certification role with alpha=.025; failure uses the qualified endpoint.
evaluation: The 1000-query cold-evaluation role is read only after action and certification decisions are fixed.
mandatory_reproduction_gate: TCP_REGISTERED and ENDPOINT arrays must exactly equal paper/sigmod2027/evidence/w6_audit paired arrays.
overwrite_policy: Create a new output directory; never modify parent results.
